housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of USD 2,454.06 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Seattle city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Seattle. No supported market-wide deposit norm was found; Seattle instead caps the combined security deposit and nonrefundable move-in fees at one month's rent: https://www.seattle.gov/construction-and-inspections/codes/common-code-questions/move-in-charges. Zillow has a Seattle rental-listings portal: https://www.zillow.com/seattle-wa/rentals/.

banking.summary: Bank of America's official international-professional page requires a physical U.S. address, proof of foreign and U.S. addresses, two forms of identification, and a foreign tax identification number; accepted primary ID includes a foreign passport: https://info.bankofamerica.com/en/international/professional-bank-account.
required_docs: Proof of home or permanent residence address
Two forms of identification (one primary and one secondary)
Foreign Tax Identification Number, or U.S. TIN/ITIN if already issued

schools.summary: Seattle Public Schools offers the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme and Career-related Programme and lists the Seattle schools offering each: https://www.seattleschools.org/departments/high-school-college-career/advanced-level-and-alternative-courses/ib/.

legal_admin.summary: Most noncitizens must report a change of U.S. address to USCIS within 10 days of moving, using the online change-of-address tool or paper Form AR-11; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt: https://www.uscis.gov/addresschange.
legal_admin.registration_step: Report the Seattle address to USCIS within 10 days of moving through a USCIS online account or by filing Form AR-11, unless exempt.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer with a federal tax purpose who is not eligible for a Social Security number applies to the IRS for an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number; the IRS says to apply by mail or in person with an ITIN application package: https://www.irs.gov/tin/itin/individual-taxpayer-identification-number-itin.

transport.summary: King County Metro is Seattle's principal bus network; its current adult USD 3 fare corresponds to a USD 108 monthly PugetPass: https://kingcounty.gov/en/dept/metro/fares-and-payment/prices. New Washington residents must obtain a state licence within 30 days: https://dol.wa.gov/moving-washington/get-driver-license. Adults with valid licences from listed reciprocal jurisdictions avoid tests, while licences from unlisted countries or Canadian provinces require the first-licence process: https://dol.wa.gov/pa/node/254. Newcomers can apply online or through a navigator via Washington Healthplanfinder, which screens for Apple Health (Medicaid) and other programs subject to immigration-status and income eligibility: https://wahealthplanfinder.org/us/en/health-coverage/who-can-sign-up/immigrants.html.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Obtain a Washington driver licence within 30 days of becoming a resident. Adults with a valid licence from another U.S. jurisdiction, British Columbia Class 5, Germany, or South Korea need no tests; Taiwan and Japan require translated certification; other foreign licences require the first-licence process.
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply online or with a navigator through Washington Healthplanfinder and request screening for Washington Apple Health (Medicaid); eligibility depends on income and immigration category.
